Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Support & Solutions

[vc_column_text]Get clear answers to the most common questions about Dhinimex services.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column]

What is your service area?

We provide comprehensive solutions in:

  • MV 22kV and 35kV electricity distribution network construction
  • LV distribution network and distribution transformer substations
  • Metering systems, protection, and switching device installation
  • Switchgear, LVDB panels, and capacitor bank installations
  • Auto voltage regulator (AVR) and SVR installations
  • On- and off-grid solar system deployment
  • Water distribution network installation
  • Maintenance and troubleshooting services

How many years of experience do you have?

We bring nearly 22 years of proven expertise across multiple engineering and construction disciplines.

What services do you offer?

  • Electrical and heavy equipment supply
  • Construction and installation services
  • Engineering and consultation services
  • Manufacturing and repair services

Do you have enough manpower and machinery to complete projects?

Yes. Our team consists of qualified engineers, skilled workers, and technicians dedicated to delivering projects efficiently. We are equipped with modern tools and machinery, ensuring projects are completed on time and to the highest quality standards.

What is the construction process?

Our process follows a structured approach:

  1. Site visit and consultation with the project owner
  2. Preparation of BOQ and detailed drawings
  3. Proposal submission and customer approval
  4. Procurement and delivery of equipment
  5. Construction, testing, and commissioning
  6. Project handover and after-sales support

What happens if the project goes over budget?

We work closely with clients to prepare BOQs that align with budget requirements. If additional work is required beyond the agreed scope, we will communicate transparently and reach a mutual agreement before proceeding.

How long does it take to get an estimate?

Following a site inspection and consultation, we provide estimates, BOQs, and drawings for approval within approximately one week.

Will I be able to request changes during the project?

Yes. Any changes requested during the project will be reviewed, discussed, and agreed upon to ensure alignment with client expectations.
